messages.content: 你能使用 get_stock_prices 函數來檢索蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價嗎？。

function.name: get_stock_prices
function.description: Retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

companies.description: List of companies to retrieve stock prices for.

duration.description: Time duration to retrieve stock prices for. E.g., '1 week', '2 weeks', '1 month', etc.

The function signature expects companies: string[], duration: string. But we need to provide separate calls for each company/duration combination? The user says "retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration". They want to retrieve for each company separately? Or maybe they want to call the function multiple times with different durations. The function can only take one duration per call. So we need to call it four times, each with one company and one duration. But the user might want all four companies for each duration. That would be 4 companies * 4 durations = 16 calls. But the function signature only allows one duration per call. We could pass all companies at once but only one duration. But the user specifically wants each company for each duration. So we need to call the function 4 times, each with one company and one duration. But the user might want all combinations. Let's interpret: "retrieves stock prices for Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Tesla respectively in 1 week, 2 weeks, 3 weeks, 1 month time ranges." That implies Apple for 1 week, Microsoft for 2 weeks, Amazon for 3 weeks, Tesla for 1 month. So we need 4 calls: Apple 1 week, Microsoft 2 weeks, Amazon 3 weeks, Tesla 1 month. We'll do that.

We need to output the function calls. According to guidelines, we should not output anything else. So we will produce 4 function calls.
